semanticAnalysis.negation: Preserve any quoted denial or not-alone relationship exactly.

animationPlan.motivation: The line becomes an unmistakable transaction and consequence.
animationPlan.anticipation: employer and worker orient head and weight toward the acting object before contact.
animationPlan.contact: cash packet meets the receiving wrist; hands and any held prop share the same rig socket.
animationPlan.weightShift: Standing actors shift over the supporting foot; seated actors remain anchored through hips and chair.
animationPlan.actionPeak: cash packet meets the receiving wrist
animationPlan.followThrough: The action settles with a readable hold before cut to abstract headcount.
animationPlan.secondaryMotion: exit desk uses offset breathing, tool response or environmental motion without synchronized looping.
animationPlan.gaze: Head direction leads toward the active hand, evidence or conversation partner.
animationPlan.cameraMotivation: locked bilateral framing supports the narrated relationship rather than decorative drift.

review.start: Opening state establishes exit desk with readable subject hierarchy.

issues: Checked hand contact, text collisions, floor contact and unsupported factual additions.
fixes: Aligned held props to wrists, corrected baselines and separated text bands where required.
